inspect_booking_storage: Scheduler.book constructs a Booking and stores it in a dictionary keyed by identifier after record validation.
Booking and Window are frozen dataclasses; Window requires datetime boundaries and a positive duration.
Booking again with the same identifier replaces the existing record; separate instances retain independent dictionaries.
The public exports are Scheduler, Window, Booking and expand_dates.
inspect_policy_boundary: Scheduler.book does not enforce overlap or capacity policy; it validates and stores a record.
Availability and remaining_capacity are separate calculation helpers that book does not call.
Two overlapping records on the same resource are both accepted and stored in this fixture.
inspect_endpoint_behavior: The contract describes half-open windows, but current overlaps returns True for touching endpoints because its comparisons are inclusive.
clip_window constructs a Window even for a nonpositive intersection and therefore raises ValueError.
Window validates that its datetime boundaries have positive duration; this validation explains the rejection.
inspect_recurrence_behavior: The daily end date is excluded because expand_dates uses a strict less-than loop; weekday filtering uses Monday 0 through Sunday 6.
Monthly recurrence uses date.replace with start.month plus offset, without year rollover or day clamping.
December rollover and month-end dates fail with ValueError rather than being handled by the implementation.
inspect_timezone_behavior: utc_timestamp uses replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) to relabel the timezone rather than convert the original instant.
Its instant is changed incorrectly for a nonzero offset: local 09:00 at UTC+02 remains 09:00 UTC rather than 07:00 UTC.
An aware datetime is required; naive datetimes are rejected with ValueError. Formatting uses seconds precision and the +00:00 suffix.
inspect_notification_boundary: Scheduler.reminders returns a dictionary mapping booking identifiers to calculated datetimes by calling reminder_time.
The default lead is 15 minutes, but current start + lead arithmetic places the reminder after start.
There is no email dispatch, background worker or notification delivery; no live clock or now call is consulted.
inspect_cancellation_behavior: drop_booking locates the identifier but filters out every booking on the matched resource, so other same-resource bookings are removed too.
Scheduler.cancel rebuilds the bookings dictionary from the resulting records; an unknown identifier leaves records unchanged.
It does not mutate a Booking's cancelled field; the retained frozen records still have cancelled False.
inspect_external_dependencies: Bookings live in an instance dictionary in memory, with no durable database persistence.
There is no HTTP transport or dispatch implementation; helper results remain local calculations.
Imports use the standard library and this local package. External deployment systems are unverified by the inspected fixture.
